physical.counting_rule: source_loc_all_files counts newlines in every regular file under a recorded path; source_loc_code_only counts newlines in .py and .js files only. Both are recomputed by check_trackers.py. The former single 'source_loc: 9896' was not reproducible under either rule: it mixed code-only counts for _hf_spaces_proxy/_hf_spaces_model with an all-files count for _cf_worker, and recorded dev_proxy.py as ~1800 lines when it is 362.
